confirmed_items.section: Experiments with full text not obtained
confirmed_items.location: Line 1403: "37 papers that appear in other sections because they were screened from their abstracts."
confirmed_items.claim: The 37 additional papers in to-download.html were screened from their abstracts.
confirmed_items.problem: The count of 37 is correct for download-list entries outside the experiment table, but their screening-source label is wrong. This group includes papers screened from complete remote PDFs or full-text XML, as well as papers screened from metadata without an abstract. Having no full text saved locally does not establish abstract-only screening.
confirmed_items.evidence: to-download.html contains 264 distinct paper IDs; report-data.json.status_by_cid identifies 227 of them as no_fulltext, leaving 37, including c029, c049, c134, and c061. forms/c029.json.source.version records reading the journal full-text JATS XML (PMC12546817). forms/c049.json.source.version records reading the complete 11-page preprint PDF in memory. forms/c134.json.source.version records reading the 15-page CHI version-of-record PDF in memory. forms/c061.json.source.version says "metadata only" and explicitly states that no abstract was available. tools/assemble_report.py, download_sentence(), counts the set difference without checking these source fields.

verdict.correct_value: `docs/creativity-screening/to-download.html` lists the 264 papers on the screening paths that have no full text on file, with every link found: the 227 papers in this table and 37 papers that appear in other sections.
verdict.evidence: Independently read creativity-screening-2026-10-04.md:1403 and verified the disputed description is present. Parsed to-download.html and report-data.json.status_by_cid: 264 distinct download-list IDs, 227 with status no_fulltext, and 37 others; all 37 have entries in other report sections. The 37 include c029, c049, c134, and c061. Reading source.version directly in each corresponding forms/<cid>.json (line 7) shows that c029 was screened from Europe PMC full-text JATS XML, c049 from the complete preprint PDF read in memory, c134 from the version-of-record PDF read in memory, and c061 from metadata only with no abstract available. Thus the group cannot be described as screened from abstracts. tools/assemble_report.py:121-130 computes the set difference and unconditionally attaches the abstract-screening description at line 127; line 178 inserts it into this report section. The sentence is absent from report-prose.md and report-generated.md. The fix belongs in the assembler; retain the computed counts and remove the unsupported screening-source explanation.
